name: Second Brain
description: Bind-mounts a host 'second brain' knowledge-base directory - taken from the host environment variable SECOND_BRAIN_DIR - into the container at /mnt/second-brain, so session-derived knowledge (notes, decisions, environment quirks) survives container rebuilds and is editable from both host and container. The variable MUST be set on the host: when it is unset or empty the container build fails fast with a clear error instead of silently mounting nothing. The Feature enforces no content conventions - structure and the skills that read/write the knowledge base come separately.
